items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: Jonah Jones and Doc Cheatham and Shad Collins were the trumpets.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. Well, he had that number with Basie. But, you know, it's --

Oh, and I tell you another thing what happened. You know, Illinois is a quiet man until he has a few drinks. So when I first got into Nice that night, we had the night off. And I come down. Here comes Illinois and Joe Newman downstairs, and they were both juiced. So they went in the restaurant, come in the restaurant and was arguing with the man because, you know, you can't get something to eat in there. And they was arguing with the man about getting something to eat.

And so I was hungry too, so I says, well, let's all of us go and find someplace to eat. So we -- Illinois and Newman and myself, we go up the street where the restaurants were, and we saw Doc Cheatham in a restaurant eating, so we went in there to sit down to eat.
